long_definition: More than 512 BERT content tokens, excluding special tokens
requests_per_document: Ten reports with five requests each, ten additional reports with eight requests each.
source: Retained 100 requests unchanged plus 100 additions, 80 long and 20 short.
independence: Assistant-authored synthetic data; fifty short requests were examined in the preceding initial evaluation. Report structures and instruction templates are shared. Long requests share twenty reports. Not an independent real-user sample.
selection: All earlier 100 retained, regardless of correctness. All additional prompts and labels saved before inference; no post-result filtering or edits.

addition_protocol.selection: All 100 additions frozen before inference; no filtering by predictions. 80 long requests share ten new source reports (eight requests per report); twenty new short requests. Source-report structures and instruction templates are shared.
addition_protocol.independence: Synthetic assistant-authored data; related variants, not 100 independent real-user requests.
